Retain realistic texture, plausible contact shadows and clear subject separation. No added text or watermarks. Suggested camera directions describe a look, not guaranteed tool controls.

6–8 seconds: PAYOFF: Hold the natural smile and resting spoon; no knives, new ingredients or reset of the stirring action.
Keep the same subject count, identities, wardrobe and exact supplied products throughout. No morphing, flicker, added people or invented text. The final hold is included in the duration; do not force a loop that requires teleportation. Preview must communicate without audio.
